title: A flat local map with the same maximal ideal and residue field is an isomorphism on completions
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m_A)$ and $(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local rings and $\varphi:A\to B$ a flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] local homomorphism ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_A)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$) such that $\mathfrak m_AB=\mathfrak m_B$ and the induced map of residue fields $A/\mathfrak m_A\to B/\mathfrak m_B$ is an isomorphism. Let $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_nA/\mathfrak m_A^n$ and $B^\wedge=\varprojlim_nB/\mathfrak m_B^n$ be the $\mathfrak m_A$-adic and $\mathfrak m_B$-adic completions [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], with canonical maps $\iota_A:A\to A^\wedge$, $\iota_B:B\to B^\wedge$. Let $\varphi^\wedge:A^\wedge\to B^\wedge$ be the ring map $(a_n\bmod\mathfrak m_A^n)_n\mapsto(\varphi(a_n)\bmod\mathfrak m_B^n)_n$ (well defined since $\varphi(\mathfrak m_A^n)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B^n$); it satisfies $\varphi^\wedge\circ\iota_A=\iota_B\circ\varphi$. Then $\varphi^\wedge$ is an isomorphism of rings.
